what: The moment the last section of the page touches the bottom, that section is pinned to the screen, and the dark footer hidden below the screen rises from below over the footer height of scrolling (scrub 0, no curve) and covers it. The body stays still while the footer rises like a cover.

options.start: When pinning and covering start, default bottom bottom (last section’s bottom edge at the bottom of the screen)
options.sel: Selector to use when the footer is outside the last section (e.g. .site-foot)
options.[data-fx-part=footer]: Footer that rises up (required) — placed at the screen bottom with position: fixed

note: The original pins the final section inside ScrollSmoother — if a smooth-scroll build exists, ScrollSmoother replaces data-fx-scroller for window scroll, so it attaches as is. If the footer is taller than the screen, the bottom is cut off (the original is also 100vh)

from.where: On all pages [data-foot-pin] + .rx-foot — last section pinned, ink-dark footer y 100% → 0
